Classification: INTERNAL. Purpose: creates the call log database and its design document. Related Docs: services/successor/README.md, ADR-0016.
description: Call log of the successor: database successor_calls and the design document call_log with the view by_task and the field documentation.

aaas_documentation.database: successor_calls: one document per successor call of a task. The document _id is <taskId>:<n>, the natural key of a call: an addition computes the successor of every value from a to a + b - 1 once, so a retried call finds its own document. Documents are never updated or deleted by the service.

fields._id: <taskId>:<n>, the natural key of the call.
fields.taskId: Task the call was made for (lowercase UUIDv7).
fields.eventId: eventId of the aaas.successor.called.v1 event published for the call (UUIDv7).
fields.event: That event exactly as published (JSON text); a retried call publishes it again.
fields.calledAt: When the call was first served (UTC, ISO 8601 with milliseconds).
fields.traceId: Trace identifier of the first request (W3C Trace Context).

views.by_task: Key [taskId, n], value result: the calls of one task in order of their argument.

by_task.map: function (doc) { if (doc.taskId && typeof doc.n === 'number') { emit([doc.taskId, doc.n], doc.result); } }
